name: Golem, Tin
body:
Tin Golem CR 5

XP 1,600
N Large construct
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 11, flat-footed 18 (+1 Dex, +8 natural)
hp 51 (6d10+18)
Fort +2, Ref +3, Will +4
DR 5/bludgeoning; Immune construct traits

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee 2 slams +13 (1d6+4)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 18; Dex 12, Con —, Int —; Wis 11; Cha 1
Base Atk +9; CMB +17; CMD 27

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Fast Healing (Ex)

Tin golems have fast healing 2.

Soften earth and stone causes a tin golem to lose its damage reduction and fast healing permanently.

A transmute metal to wood spell causes a tin golem 6d10 damage.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary or gang (2–4)
Treasure none

A tin golem has an solidly crafted body shaped like a humanoid. Like other golems, a tin golem cannot speak and makes grinding sounds when it moves. A tin golem is 7 feet tall and weighs around 1,500 pounds. A tin golem’s body is an amalgam of tin and other non-precious metals, and is molded from a single mold. The heart of a tin golem is a large topaz, worth at least 500 gp.

Crafting this Golem

CL 9th; Price 47,000 gp

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Construct; Spells animate object, rapid repair, make whole; Special creator must be caster level 9th; Skill Checks Craft (blacksmithing) or Craft (jewelrymaking) DC 18; Cost 25,000 gp
